description: Enhance the ECS worker's error reporting to provide actionable resolution hints for common task submission failures. When the ECS worker encounters specific errors during task run creation, it should display helpful guidance to users about how to resolve the underlying issues.
functional_requirements: Detect when ECS task submission fails due to an inactive task definition and provide a hint suggesting to re-register the task definition or remove the task_definition_arn from configuration
Identify capacity provider errors during task submission and provide guidance about Fargate/EC2 capacity provider configuration
Recognize network configuration errors (subnet/security group/network InvalidParameterException) and point users to work pool network settings for resolution
Refactor the error reporting method to compute exception string representation once for efficiency and maintainability
Add comprehensive test coverage for all new error hint scenarios using parametrized tests
